text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 27, 2025) for 44 Holland Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Rescinded the Property Standards Order (March 27, 2025) for 44 Holland Avenue, Folder No. 25 135531 PRS 00 IV, subject to the appellant forwarding the communication from the tenant to the Municipal Standards Officer, Municipal Licensing and Standards confirming that the tenants are vacating the subject property.
